title: cephalocarpus rigidus var. typicus
intro: Cephalocarpus rigidus var. typicus, commonly known as a type of fern, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cephalocarpaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cephalocarpus rigidus var. typicus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in supporting immune function. Bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
